# M0-S5: a loGo/s module defaults to cgo forbid. With no logos.toml,
# a package with import "C" fails with restriction::cgo_usage.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Clear any host CGO_ENABLED: the default case needs no explicit env, and an
# inherited CGO_ENABLED=1 would win over the absent-key default instead.
env CGO_ENABLED=

[cgo] ! logos build .
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] cgo is disabled'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/cgodefault

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("default:", C.answer()) }
